title: GitHub - AnayGarodia/sketchling: A hand-drawn illustration and animation language for LLMs
excerpt: A hand-drawn illustration and animation language for LLMs - AnayGarodia/sketchling
content_html:
A hand drawn illustration and animation language for LLMs. Manim gave language models a way to express math visually in code. Sketchling does the same for expressive, hand drawn illustration and motion — not a diagramming DSL, not a general 3D engine, a vocabulary for drawing and moving things by hand.

This is the closing shot of The Lantern Maker, a nine scene, three minute short film. An artisan crafts a paper lantern by lamplight, then carries it through a darkening town to release it from a bridge at night. Watch the full thing at docs/story-lantern-maker.mp4.

Nobody hand animated this. Devin built it cold, working from nothing but this repository's own docs, the same way every example in examples/ was built: an LLM writing TypeScript against a vocabulary, not a human hand authoring vector art. That is the actual point of sketchling. If a coding agent can read a README and come out the other side with a real hand drawn film, the vocabulary is doing its job.

A few more scenes from the same batch, also built cold, also unedited:

More stills from the same set: lighthouse watch, campfire story, market street, summit sunrise, snow village, moonlit sail. Full videos for all of these live in docs/, source in examples/showcase/.

Everything above shares one register — hand-drawn ink, restrained and muted — because it's one batch, not a ceiling. Same library, same primitives, different look/texture, three more coding agents building cold on three unrelated subjects:

Install

npm install -g sketchling
npx playwright install chromium

The second line is a one time step. Rendering runs through a real headless Chromium browser (via Playwright), not a canvas library, so the first install pulls down a Chromium binary, a couple hundred MB. Video export also needs ffmpeg on your PATH. A still only workflow does not.

Quick start

import { sketch } from "sketchling";

const scene = sketch.scene({ width: 480, height: 420, background: "#7096c6" });

const lid = sketch.loop(
  [[70, 55], [330, 55], [330, 245], [70, 245]],
  { color: "#15130f", weight: "bold", looseness: 0.22, smooth: false }
);
scene.add(lid).drawOn({ at: 0, duration: 0.5 });

export default scene;
sketchling render scene.ts --out preview.png
sketchling render scene.ts --video preview.mp4 --fps 24
sketchling render scene.ts --serve

Working inside a clone of this repo instead of a published install? Import from ../src/index.js in place of "sketchling", or run npm link once you have built.

For coding agents

Every film in this README, including The Lantern Maker at the top, was built by handing an agent a prompt like this and nothing else:

Using the sketchling npm package, build a short hand-drawn animated film about
[subject]. Read AGENTS.md in the package for the full API. Pick a look/texture
on purpose instead of defaulting to look: "ink". Render it, run
`sketchling validate`, and fix anything it flags before calling it done.

AGENTS.md is the actual reference — every primitive, every animation, every gotcha found the hard way, written for an agent to read cold and act on, not summarized marketing copy. It's also installed as .claude/skills/sketchling/ and .agents/skills/sketchling/ so it loads automatically in repos that use those conventions.

Why this exists

Ask an LLM to hand code an SVG path for a person or a tree and you get something crude. Two choices make hand drawn illustration tractable for a model instead:

  1. The vocabulary is expressive, not geometric. There is no Circle() or Arc(). Primitives take character parameters like weight, looseness, and energy, not just coordinates. A loose stroke hides imprecision by design instead of exposing it.
  2. The renderer is forgiving by default. Every shape draws through a rough.js based sketchy engine: jittered strokes, imperfect closure, variable width. Slightly off geometry reads as style, not as a mistake, the same slack that lets a hand drawn line hide a shaky hand.

Core capabilities

Hand drawn primitives. stroke, loop, blob, group, text, plus small compositions like arrow and speechBubble. Style knobs (weight, looseness, energy, fill) control how imperfect and how expressive a shape reads, not just its geometry.

Real animation, not just tweening. drawOn reveals a shape the way a hand actually draws it, tracing the outline first and filling in after, with a pen tip riding the leading edge. Line boil keeps a finished stroke subtly alive rather than looking frozen the instant it lands.

Labeled, relative scheduling. Every animation lives on one timeline, but you don't have to hand-compute absolute seconds for it: scene.label("liftoff", 4.2) names a moment, and any later at can reference it ("liftoff+0.4"), with node.endAt chaining a sequence off whatever just finished — instead of a wall of hand-tallied literals.

IK rigging and procedural gait. sketch.limb gives you a two bone chain solved from a target position. sketch.walk turns two of those into a full bipedal gait, feet planting without sliding, arms counter swinging with the legs, generated from step count and stride length rather than hand tuned per pose.

Camera and film. Pan and zoom through a world bigger than one screen, follow a moving character, or cut several independent scenes together into one continuous piece with sketch.film(), the tool The Lantern Maker itself is built with.

Secondary motion. springTo and sketch.connector give you damped spring lag and a bendable line that tracks a live target, the difference between an ear that snaps to a new angle and one that actually flops.

Real shading. sketch.shade(baseColor, options) derives a full highlight to shadow gradient from one color and a light direction, instead of hand picking two or three hex values per shape.

Particles and sound. A closed form particle emitter (sparks, snow, confetti, dust) with no simulation step, and sketch.sound() for scheduled notes and hits synthesized directly into the exported video's audio track.

Five looks, three textures. "ink", "flat", "clay", "lit3d", and "toon3d" change how geometry itself renders. "watercolor", "grain", and "pixel" are an independent whole frame texture layered on top of any of them.

The complete reference for all of this, including every gotcha found the hard way, lives in AGENTS.md — see "For coding agents" above.

How it works

A scene graph is built by running your scene.ts in plain Node, no DOM involved, which is cheap enough to lint before a single pixel exists. That serialized scene is then handed to a headless Chromium page, where rough.js draws it as SVG and GSAP drives the timeline. Renders are deterministic: the same scene at the same timestamp produces byte identical output, which makes cmp a real verification tool, not just an eyeball check.

Status

Early and opinionated by design. The bet is a small, well designed vocabulary — primitives with character, not a Circle()/Arc() geometry API — beats a sprawling one that does everything adequately. Five looks and three textures exist today ("ink", "flat", "clay", "lit3d", "toon3d", "watercolor", "grain", "pixel"), because "opinionated" means a small deliberate vocabulary, not one fixed aesthetic — the gallery above is five of them on five unrelated subjects, not one register wearing different clothes.

Contributing

Issues and PRs are welcome. See CONTRIBUTING.md for setup, how to verify a change by actually rendering it, and what a good PR looks like. CHANGELOG.md tracks what shipped in each version.

License

MIT. See LICENSE.

blocks.html_en: How it works

sentences.en: How it works
sentences.zh: 它是如何运作的

blocks.html_en: A scene graph is built by running your scene.ts in plain Node, no DOM involved, which is cheap enough to lint before a single pixel exists. That serialized scene is then handed to a headless Chromium page, where rough.js draws it as SVG and GSAP drives the timeline. Renders are deterministic: the same scene at the same timestamp produces byte identical output, which makes cmp a real verification tool, not just an eyeball check.

blocks.html_en: Early and opinionated by design. The bet is a small, well designed vocabulary — primitives with character, not a Circle()/Arc() geometry API — beats a sprawling one that does everything adequately. Five looks and three textures exist today ("ink", "flat", "clay", "lit3d", "toon3d", "watercolor", "grain", "pixel"), because "opinionated" means a small deliberate vocabulary, not one fixed aesthetic — the gallery above is five of them on five unrelated subjects, not one register wearing different clothes.

content_html_zh:
适合法学硕士的手绘插图和动画语言。 Manim 为语言模型提供了一种用代码直观地表达数学的方法。 草图绘制对于富有表现力的手绘插图和动作也有同样的作用——不是图表 DSL，不是通用的 3D 引擎，而是手动绘制和移动物体的词汇。

这是《灯笼制造者》的结束镜头，这是一部九个场景、三分钟的短片。 一位工匠在灯光下制作纸灯笼，然后带着它穿过黑暗的小镇，在夜间从桥上释放出来。 观看完整内容请访问 docs/story-lantern-maker.mp4。

没有人手工制作这个。 Devin 冷酷地构建了它，除了这个存储库自己的文档之外什么都没有，就像示例/中的每个示例的构建方式一样：一个法学硕士根据词汇表编写 TypeScript，而不是人类手工创作矢量艺术。 这才是素描的真正意义所在。 如果编码代理可以阅读自述文件并从另一面拿出真实的手绘电影，那么词汇表就发挥了作用。

同一批的另外几个场景，也是冷建的，也未经编辑：

更多同组剧照：灯塔守望、篝火故事、集市街、山顶日出、雪村、月光风帆。 所有这些内容的完整视频位于 docs/ 中，源代码位于 Examples/showcase/ 中。

上面的所有东西都共享一个寄存器——手绘墨水，克制和静音——因为它是一批，而不是上限。 相同的库，相同的基元，不同的外观/纹理，另外三个编码代理在三个不相关的主题上构建冷库：

安装

npm install -g sketchling
npx playwright install chromium

第二行是一次性步骤。 渲染通过真正的无头 Chromium 浏览器（通过 Playwright）运行，而不是画布库，因此第一次安装会下载一个 Chromium 二进制文件，大小为几百 MB。 视频导出还需要在您的 PATH 中添加 ffmpeg。 仍然只有工作流程则不然。

快速启动

import { sketch } from "sketchling";

const scene = sketch.scene({ width: 480, height: 420, background: "#7096c6" });

const lid = sketch.loop(
  [[70, 55], [330, 55], [330, 245], [70, 245]],
  { color: "#15130f", weight: "bold", looseness: 0.22, smooth: false }
);
scene.add(lid).drawOn({ at: 0, duration: 0.5 });

export default scene;
sketchling render scene.ts --out preview.png
sketchling render scene.ts --video preview.mp4 --fps 24
sketchling render scene.ts --serve

在这个存储库的克隆中工作而不是在已发布的安装中工作？ 从 ../src/index.js 导入代替“sketchling”，或者在构建后运行 npm link。

对于编码剂

本自述文件中的每一部电影，包括顶部的《灯笼制造者》，都是通过向特工提供这样的提示而制作的，仅此而已：

Using the sketchling npm package, build a short hand-drawn animated film about
[subject]. Read AGENTS.md in the package for the full API. Pick a look/texture
on purpose instead of defaulting to look: "ink". Render it, run
`sketchling validate`, and fix anything it flags before calling it done.

AGENTS.md 是实际的参考资料——每一个原语、每一个动画、每一个陷阱都是通过艰难的方式找到的，是为代理编写的，可供冷酷阅读并采取行动，而不是总结的营销文案。 它还安装为 .claude/skills/sketchling/ 和 .agents/skills/sketchling/ ，因此它会在使用这些约定的存储库中自动加载。

为什么存在这个

要求法学硕士手工编写一个人或一棵树的 SVG 路径，你会得到一些粗糙的东西。 有两种选择可以使手绘插图更适合模型：

  1. 词汇是表达性的，而不是几何性的。 没有 Circle() 或 Arc()。 基元采用重量、松散度和能量等角色参数，而不仅仅是坐标。 松散的笔触隐藏了设计上的不精确性，而不是暴露它。
  2. 渲染器默认是宽容的。 每个形状都是通过基于 rough.js 的粗略引擎绘制的：抖动的笔画、不完美的闭合、可变的宽度。 稍微偏离的几何形状被解读为风格，而不是错误，就像手绘的线条掩盖了颤抖的手一样的松弛。

核心能力

手绘基元。 笔画、循环、斑点、组、文本，以及箭头和语音气泡等小组合。 风格旋钮（重量、松散度、能量、填充）控制形状的不完美程度和表现力，而不仅仅是其几何形状。

真正的动画，而不仅仅是补间。 DrawOn 以手实际绘制形状的方式显示形状，先描出轮廓，然后填充，笔尖位于前缘。 线条煮沸使完成的笔画巧妙地保持活力，而不是在落地时看起来冻结。

标记的、相对的调度。 每个动画都存在于一个时间轴上，但您不必为其手动计算绝对秒数： scene.label("liftoff", 4.2) 命名一个时刻，任何稍后的 at 都可以引用它（"liftoff+0.4"），用 node.endAt 将刚刚完成的序列链接起来，而不是手工统计的文字墙。

I 索具和程序步态。 sketch.limb 为您提供从目标位置求解的两根骨骼链。 sketch.walk 将其中的两种步态转变为完整的双足步态，双脚落地而不滑动，手臂随腿摆动，由步数和步长生成，而不是根据每个姿势手动调整。

相机和胶卷。 平移和缩放一个比一个屏幕更大的世界，跟随一个移动的角色，或者使用 sketch.film()（The Lantern Maker 本身的构建工具）将几个独立的场景剪切成一个连续的片段。

二次运动。 springTo 和 sketch.connector 为您提供阻尼弹簧滞后和跟踪实时目标的可弯曲线，这是捕捉到新角度的耳朵与实际失败的耳朵之间的区别。

真正的阴影。 sketch.shade(baseColor, options) 从一种颜色和光线方向导出完整的高光到阴影渐变，而不是为每个形状手动选择两个或三个十六进制值。

粒子和声音。 一个封闭形式的粒子发射器（火花、雪、五彩纸屑、灰尘），没有模拟步骤，以及 sketch.sound() 用于预定的音符和直接合成到导出视频的音轨中的点击。

五种外观，三种纹理。 “ink”、“flat”、“clay”、“lit3d”和“toon3d”改变几何体本身的渲染方式。 “水彩”、“颗粒”和“像素”是叠加在其中任何一个之上的独立的整帧纹理。

所有这些的完整参考，包括每一个困难发现的问题，都位于 AGENTS.md 中 — 请参阅上面的“对于编码代理”。

它是如何运作的

场景图是通过在普通 Node 中运行 scene.ts 来构建的，不涉及 DOM，这足够便宜，可以在单个像素存在之前进行 lint 检测。 然后，序列化的场景会被传递到无头 Chromium 页面，其中 rough.js 会在 SVG 和 GSAP 驱动时间线时绘制它。 渲染是确定性的：相同时间戳的相同场景会产生字节相同的输出，这使得 cmp 成为真正的验证工具，而不仅仅是眼球检查。

地位

设计较早且固执己见。 赌注是一个小而精心设计的词汇表——具有字符的基元，而不是 Circle()/Arc() 几何 API——击败了一个能充分完成所有工作的庞大词汇表。 今天存在五种外观和三种纹理（“墨水”、“平面”、“粘土”、“lit3d”、“toon3d”、“水彩”、“颗粒”、“像素”），因为“固执己见”意味着一个小的、经过深思熟虑的词汇，而不是一种固定的审美——上面的画廊是五个不相关主题的五个，没有一个穿着不同的衣服。

贡献

欢迎提出问题和 PR。 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 了解设置、如何通过实际渲染来验证更改以及良好的 PR 是什么样子。 CHANGELOG.md 跟踪每个版本中发布的内容。

执照

和。 请参阅许可证。
